interface.name: list_products
interface.title: List Store Products
interface.description: Returns a paginated list of the store's products with their price, stock quantity and sale status, optionally narrowed by a name/SKU keyword, a status, or a category.
whenToUse: The merchant wants to see what they sell, e.g. 'what products do I have?' or 'show me my catalogue'.
The merchant asks whether a product exists or wants to find it by name or SKU, e.g. 'do I still sell the leather wallet?' -- filter with the keyword argument.

The merchant asks which products are out of stock or hidden from the storefront -- filter with the status argument ('out' or 'hidden'), and report stock from each product's quantity rather than its status.
The merchant wants the products that sit inside one category, e.g. 'what's in my shoes category?' -- filter with the categoryId argument.
An agent needs product ids, SKUs or current prices before reporting on or acting on specific products.
whenNotToUse: The merchant named ONE specific product and wants its full details, variants or options -- use get_product with the product id instead.
The merchant wants the store's categories themselves rather than the products in them -- use list_categories instead.
The merchant wants to change a product's price, stock or visibility -- this tool only reads; use update_product instead.

page.description: Pagination page number. The response returns one page of products; increment to fetch the rest.

keyword.description: Filter products to those whose name or SKU matches this keyword.

status.description: Filter products by storefront state: 'sale' (on sale), 'out' (out of stock) or 'hidden' (not shown in the storefront). 'out' selects on stock availability, so it returns products holding no stock even when their own status field still reads 'sale' -- see the quantity field in the response.

categoryId.description: Return only the products included in this category. The id comes from list_categories.

id.description: The product id, used by sibling product tools.

sku.description: The merchant's stock keeping unit for the product.

status.description: The product's own storefront state: 'sale', 'out' or 'hidden'. It can still read 'sale' for a product holding no stock, so do not report stock from this field -- read quantity instead.

quantity.description: Units currently in stock, and the field to trust when answering a stock question: 0 means none left. Null for a product that does not track stock (unlimited quantity).

currency.description: ISO currency code of the store, e.g. 'SAR'.

ui._comment: A row per product. Paths inside the template are RELATIVE -- `name`, not `/name` -- because the List instantiates it once per item in /items.

components._comment: quantity, not status: 'sale' can still mean nothing left.

http.summary: List Products -- list all available products related to your store, filterable by a keyword matching a product name or SKU, by status, and by category.

query.name: keyword
query.description: A keyword to filter products that match a specific name or SKU value.

query.name: status
query.description: The status of the product: 'sale', 'out' or 'hidden'.

query.name: category
query.description: Get products included in a specific category.

statuses.meaning: The store's access token is missing, expired, or does not carry the products.read scope, so the catalogue cannot be read until the app's authorization is fixed.

rules.message: status must be one of 'sale', 'out' or 'hidden'
categoryId must be a numeric category id, as returned by list_categories

dependencies.reason: the categoryId filter takes a category id, which the merchant's agent gets from list_categories
